id./param/scenario/cs/c_170_cs_010.pack|cs_:
"Hey, {var:1}, listen.
  Sorry to ask at a time like this,
  but I have an important favor.

"Behind this door is someone more precious
  to me than any treasure.
  ...I want you to help her.

Erik told {var:1} of his past.
Five years ago his sister Mia turned to
gold, and he fled on a journey...

"...Wandering aimlessly, I met a man
  calling himself the Seer, who gave me
  a prophecy.

"'Gather the legendary jewels and aid the
  Luminary beneath the earth. Then your
  atonement shall be fulfilled.'

"While traveling with you, I thought it over.
  ...The Sword of Light's power might
  break this curse.

"Please! Lend me your strength.
  No matter her form, she's...
  Mia is my sister!

"...I had a strange dream.
  It was lonely and scary,
  but warm in the end...

"In the dream... bro and the others
  were saving me...
"Hee hee... It's okay, I forgive you.

"So the prophecy was true.
  ...Thanks, {var:1}.
  Thanks to you, my atonement is complete.

"Now it's my turn to live up to your
  expectations. Count on me, partner!
